subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What aspects of the films are reviewers focusing on?

judge.implied_focus: The specific cinematic aspects/dimensions of a film that reviewers evaluate and focus on (e.g., production, performance, plot, craft, emotion, theme, genre, entertainment)

per_column.name: production_quality_focus
per_column.rationale: Captures whether reviewers focus on production quality — a distinct evaluative facet of the film aspect focus.

per_column.name: performance_quality_focus
per_column.rationale: Acting/performance is a coherent, commonly reviewed film aspect with graded evaluative values.

per_column.name: plot_coherence_focus
per_column.rationale: Plot/narrative coherence is a clear film aspect reviewers focus on.

per_column.name: technical_craft_focus
per_column.rationale: Technical craft is a valid facet, though it overlaps somewhat with production_quality.

per_column.name: emotional_resonance_focus
per_column.rationale: Emotional impact is a distinct reviewer focus dimension.

per_column.name: thematic_depth_focus
per_column.rationale: Thematic substance is a coherent evaluative aspect of films.

per_column.name: genre_expectation_focus
per_column.rationale: Genre fulfillment/subversion is a legitimate aspect reviewers attend to.

per_column.name: entertainment_level_focus
per_column.rationale: Entertainment value is a recognizable reviewer focus dimension.

judge.rationale: The columns collectively and tightly centre on ONE coherent, data-inferable focus: the specific film aspects reviewers focus on. Each column is a categorical facet with a 'not_present' level plus differentiated evaluative values, which directly operationalises 'what aspects are reviewers focusing on' — the exact query. This is a faceted decomposition, not a grab-bag or a bare-sentiment restatement, so structure_quality is high; the only mild deduction is that production_quality_focus and technical_craft_focus overlap conceptually, slightly blurring facet boundaries. The focus is highly actionable: an analyst can quantify aspect prevalence, compare focus frequency across aspects, and relate them to the label_pos sentiment. The set avoids mechanical proxies (length, token counts) and instead encodes semantically meaningful, mutually reinforcing facets, strongly realising the focus-inference claim.
